w10_T4_005883: A phone shop records call time in minutes but prints it on the bills in hours. On Monday morning the shop had 213 handsets in stock. Before lunch 130 handsets were sold to a company. In the early afternoon a delivery brought 33 more. Later that afternoon the stock was split equally between the shop's 2 branches, and the manager stayed with the branch on the high street. In the evening a supplier added 35 handsets to that branch, and a courier took 43 away for repair. How many handsets are at the high street branch now?
w10_T4_005884: A school tuck shop counts its takings in cents and banks them in dollars. The float in the tin was 15 cents on Monday morning. Sales added 37 cents, then 66 cents, then 63 cents to the same tin. The head teacher then matched the money several times over so that the tin held 5 times as much as it had. A parent later dropped 69 cents into the tin, and a teacher added 9 cents. How many cents are in the tin now?
w10_T4_005886: On Monday morning a paper mill loaded 124 reels onto each of its 5 lorries. During the afternoon 326 reels were delivered to a printer. In the evening the reels still on the lorries were unwound, and each reel gives 7 rolls. Every roll is cut into 2 wide sheets, and each sheet is stamped into 8 labels. How many labels can the mill make from what is left?
w10_T4_005887: Yara had 89 marbles in her bag at the start of the week. She lost 2 down a drain and gave 79 away to her cousins. She traded 7 more for a comic. Her friend Kwame, who keeps fewer marbles than Yara does, gave her 18 from his own bag, and her grandmother added 4 more. Yara then dropped 10 marbles into a charity jar. How many marbles are in Yara's bag now?
w10_T4_005888: Hiro keeps bees in 30 hives, and each hive holds 8 frames. Every frame fills 6 jars of honey. He sold 772 jars at the market this summer. A friend then returned 63 jars that had not sold in her shop. Hiro produced more jars this year than his neighbour Mei did, and his van drives 45 kilometres to the market. How many jars of honey does Hiro have?
w10_T4_005889: A tea packer weighs its leaves in grams although the boxes are labelled in kilograms. The factory filled 181 chests at each of its 5 loading bays. Every chest holds 9 cartons, and each carton holds 7 packets of tea. A late order added 54 loose packets to the store. All of the packets were then shared equally among the company's 3 depots. A dozen inspectors visit the factory each year. How many packets of tea went to one depot?
w10_T4_005909: A running club logs its training in minutes and posts the monthly total in hours. The club had 124 numbered vests in its kit bag, and 95 of them were handed out for a race. Each vest still in the bag was paired with 4 safety pins from the box. 12 of those pins were bent and thrown away, and a member then brought 52 more pins. The coach kept half of the pins and gave the rest to the junior team. How many pins did the coach keep?
w10_T4_005910: A community centre had 157 folding tables in its store. 4 tables were broken and taken away, and a donation brought in 12 more. The council then delivered enough tables to make the store hold 2 times as many as before. The tables were shared equally among the centre's 6 halls, and Farida took charge of the hall by the entrance. A school later lent her 75 more tables, leaving her with more tables than her colleague Omar has in his hall. How many tables are in Farida's hall?
w10_T4_005912: A publisher printed 152 books on each of its 5 presses. Every book holds 7 chapters. After a rewrite the editors cut 3953 chapters from the run. Each chapter that was kept was set on 7 pages, and 2455 pages were then lost when a machine jammed. Every page that survived carries 3 illustrations. Ines checked more pages than her colleague Karl did, and a dozen proofreaders work for the publisher. How many illustrations are in the print run?
w10_T4_005913: Nadia's cider farm had 137 barrels in the shed. 101 barrels were sent to a wholesaler. Each barrel that remained was decanted into 3 casks. A neighbour then gave the farm 75 more casks. Every cask fills 9 bottles, and 701 bottles were sold at the gate. Nadia has more bottles left than Egan has at his farm. How many bottles does Nadia's farm have?
w10_T4_005927: A print works counts its runs in sheets but quotes them to customers in reams. On Monday there were 150 boxes of paper in the store, and each box holds 5 packs. A courier then brought 10 more packs. All of the packs were shared equally among the works' 5 machines. Each pack loaded on a machine prints 9 posters, and every poster is folded into 2 leaflets. How many leaflets does one machine produce?
w10_T4_005936: On Monday morning a wholesaler had 190 sacks of rice in the store. Before lunch a delivery added 29 sacks, and in the afternoon a second delivery added 66 more. In the early evening a customer returned 5 sacks. Every sack in the store is repacked into 9 small bags for the shops. A dozen trolleys stand by the loading door. How many bags of rice will the store hold?
w10_T4_005937: On Monday morning a florist had 91 buckets of roses, and a grower delivered 13 more before noon. In the early afternoon 42 buckets were sold to a hotel. Later that afternoon each bucket still in the shop was divided into 3 vases. Every vase holds 7 roses, and in the evening 430 roses were used for a wedding. How many roses are left in the shop?
w10_T4_005946: A repair shop books its work in minutes and quotes it to customers in hours. On Monday 48 laptops arrived and were shared equally among the 3 technicians, so Bo and Lin each started with the same number. Bo sent 6 of his laptops back as beyond repair. He then took in 64 more from a school and 22 more from an office. At the end of the week Bo spread all of his laptops equally across the 6 shelves in his workroom. How many laptops are on one of those shelves?
w10_T4_005954: A campsite shop had 87 gas canisters at the start of the season. 14 canisters were returned to the supplier as faulty, and 64 were sold to campers. Each canister still on the shelf can fill 7 small lamps. A delivery then brought 79 filled lamps to the shop as well. A dozen tents are pitched behind the shop. How many lamps can the shop supply?
w10_T4_005955: A vineyard had 224 rows of vines, and 44 rows were dug up after a frost. Each remaining row produced 9 crates of grapes this year. The harvest was split equally between the vineyard's 2 owners, Pilar and Ramon, so each of them took the same number of crates. A neighbour then gave Pilar 17 extra crates. How many crates does Pilar have?
w10_T4_005960: A hospital ward had 111 blankets in its cupboard. 1 blanket was torn and thrown out, and 67 blankets went to the laundry. A delivery brought 28 clean blankets back to the cupboard, and a charity donated 28 more. The ward has 24 beds. How many blankets are in the cupboard now?
w10_T4_005961: A stadium kiosk counts its takings in cents and reports them in dollars. Before the match the kiosk had 51 boxes of pies, and the kitchen tripled the number of boxes it held. A late van brought 37 more boxes, and 31 boxes were sent over to another kiosk. Each box in the kiosk holds 9 pies, and a member of staff then carried in 9 loose pies. The stadium holds 40000 people. How many pies does the kiosk have?
w10_T4_005974: A model railway club kept 211 lengths of track in each of its 3 storage boxes. A member donated 45 more lengths, and a shop gave 13 more. The club then used 653 lengths to build a layout for an exhibition. A grant doubled the number of lengths still in the store. A visitor later handed in 20 more lengths. How many lengths of track are in the store?
w10_T4_005981: A theatre wardrobe counts its sewing time in minutes and reports it in hours. Yasmin's store held 133 rolls of fabric, a supplier delivered 76 more, and a closing shop sent 35 rolls after that. Each roll cuts into 9 costume panels. The wardrobe used 1503 panels for a musical and another 209 for a pantomime. Yasmin still has more panels than her colleague Ola has. How many panels are left in Yasmin's store?
w10_T4_005986: A bottling plant measures its output in millilitres although the labels are printed in litres. The plant had 74 pallets ready, and a lorry brought 17 more. Each pallet holds 3 cases, every case holds 5 boxes, and every box holds 4 bottles. A returned order then added 62 bottles to the store, and a short extra run added 39 more. The plant employs 120 people. How many bottles are at the plant?
w10_T4_005987: A school library had 53 boxes of books in the storeroom. 12 boxes were sent to a jumble sale, and a parents' group donated 52 boxes. A grant then doubled the number of boxes in the storeroom. The librarian sent 13 boxes on to a partner school. Each box in the storeroom holds 9 books, and the library has 4 reading tables. How many books are in the storeroom?
w10_T4_005993: A canal boatyard measures its rope in metres although its orders are still written in feet. The yard had 85 coils of rope, and a chandler delivered 57 more. Each coil is cut into 8 lengths, and every length is cut again into 4 short pieces. A boatbuilder then brought 38 short pieces over from another yard. The yard has 6 dry docks. How many short pieces of rope are in the yard?
w10_T4_005997: On Monday morning a food bank had 87 boxes of pasta, and a supermarket delivered 68 more before lunch. In the early afternoon a matched giving scheme doubled the number of boxes on the shelves. Later that afternoon a school brought 49 boxes and a church group brought 76. In the evening two neighbours dropped off 26 boxes and then 44 boxes. The food bank opens 5 days a week. How many boxes of pasta are on the shelves?
w10_T4_006004: A youth choir had 66 songbooks in its cupboard, and a donation added 64 more. A printer then delivered enough copies to make the number of songbooks 2 times as large. A member brought 27 further books from home. Each songbook in the cupboard contains 7 songs. The choir rehearses in room 9. How many songs are printed in the cupboard's songbooks altogether?
